creation: Original cartoon character atlas and four separately generated panoramic room illustrations, using the approved characters as the style reference. Simplified geometric SVG rooms were replaced after user review. Original reception illustration generated from the approved character and moon-bedroom style references; no baked-in characters or UI. Four independent original action-pose atlases were generated from the approved guest designs for the story-night update. Original hand-inked purple/gold UI frame, primary button and bat-wing nameplate generated using the reception illustration as style reference; blank centres allow real localized text. Original three-column transparent decoration atlas generated from the approved reception style: crescent floor lamp, velvet rug and star garland. Runtime alpha bounds select each sprite without resampling source artwork. Original Yuzu fox-spirit and Nemu folklore baku action atlases, plus eight new seasonal environment paintings, generated using this project’s own approved hotel/room and chibi references. No licensed character or film assets. Original transparent 2x2 room-decoration atlas: rose-heart carpet, rose curtains, flower box and tea trolley, generated using the project decoration art as reference. Original 2x2 transparent episode prop atlas: crescent travel suitcase, strawberry birthday cake, magical vine pot and golden dream key; no licensed designs. Original physical-evidence transparent atlas: bandage footprints, pink icing cloth, ribbon with bandage and an empty cake box. Road tiles are procedural SVG game geometry; comparison images compose identical original room art with exactly five authored prop changes. Original transparent painted two-storey glass gallery added in 1.25. The renderer clips its low front rail separately for depth while the same residents physically walk across both buildings; the source image is not stretched.
frames: Guests: 2x2 transparent atlas. Rooms: separate 3:1 panoramic images, framed proportionally at runtime. Reception: separate 2:1 full-screen panorama, cropped proportionally at runtime. Action poses: four separate 1254x1254 transparent 2x2 atlases, four poses per guest. Runtime alpha bounds align feet and remove unused padding without resampling source artwork. New guest atlases: 2x2 transparent grids. Seasonal lobbies: 1774x887; seasonal bedrooms: 2172x724, cropped proportionally at runtime. decor-more.png: 2x2 alpha-tight frames registered without source resampling.
